title: IVG Pro 12 Blue Raspberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Blue Raspberry Ice IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods combine a sweet, tangy Blue Raspberry flavour with a streak of cool Menthol for a smooth, refreshing vape. The fruity top notes deliver a bright berry profile, while the icy finish adds sharpness and depth. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 0mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a separate 10ml refill reservoir that connects easily to the pod. Once assembled, the refill system automatically tops up the pod as you vape — no refilling, no coil changes, and up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on usage. Mesh coil technology ensures smooth MTL vapour and consistent flavour, while the click-fit design makes setup simple and spill-free. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
